If you are receiving this message it means that your email address has been queued for deactivation.', 'Log on with username and password at: www.chase.com to verify your account information on our system.', 'We implore you to help us serve you better by upgrading your account in two easy steps.', 'Your account access will remain limited until this issue has been resolved', 'Please visit our Customer Verification Form using the link below and follow the instructions on the screen.', 'By following the link below you will commence the form of the user details approval:', 'Confirm your account and restore access.', 'Hence, we request you to unblock your HSBC bank account by clicking on the link below immediately for uninterrupted services.', 'Please upgrade your account by following the reference below', 'Please visit our Client Confirmation Page using the link below and follow the instructions on the screen.', 'IN ORDER TO CONFIRM YOUR ONLINE BANK RECORDS, WE MAY REQUIRE SOME SPECIFIC INFORMATION FROM YOU TO RESTORE YOUR ACCOUNT.', 'All customers are therefore advised to update their account details.']
